CONSOL.sd.bad CONSOL.sd.ok
  CONSOL has a great many unexplained differences.
DATE.sd.bad DATE.sd.ok
  The only difference is year group 3 in the compiled binary, and year group
  six in the release.  Presumably to be fixed in the date patches.
DIRECT.sd.bad DIRECT.sd.ok
  The only difference is year group 3 in the compiled binary, and year group
  six in the release.  Presumably to be fixed in the date patches.
FOCAL.sd.bad FOCAL.sd.ok
  FOCAL's first extent generates TOO MANY, then the size for the second
  extent is used.
MAP.sd.bad MAP.sd.ok
  MAP was eaten by the problems loading PAL.
ODT.sd.bad ODT.sd.ok
  Block 6 is empty.
PAL.sd.bad PAL.sd.ok
  PAL doesn't get added to the media with the correct size.  Both extents
  bomb with TOO MANY, then the extent size for MAP is used instead.
PRINT.sd.bad PRINT.sd.ok
  The only difference is year group 3 in the compiled binary, and year group
  six in the release.  Presumably to be fixed in the date patches.
SYSTAT.sd.bad SYSTAT.sd.ok
  The only difference is year group 3 in the compiled binary, and year group
  six in the release.  Presumably to be fixed in the date patches.

diff .boot.bad .boot.ok
The date word at offset 0010 differs: 0000 should be 5440..

diff .cat.bad .cat.ok
The build is leaving COMGEN, COMG2, DTAGEN, and DATFIX scripts.
The release should have README and TCBOOT instead.

diff .dollar.bad .dollar.ok
The "$" files are both empty, but differ.

diff .handlers.bad .handlers.ok
The handler areas differ, but only after the 16 defined handlers.

Block 12, offset 170-177 CONSOL/E needed to load the overlay.
